Also: signing several files at once; hashes compatible with desktop; file protection for specific people or with a key; co-signing and countersigning; certified date and time; detailed verification with report; eleven languages.

Earlier versions: XMLdSig, ODF, OOXML, FacturaE, ASiC-XAdES and Veri*Factu record formats; checking Veri*Factu records without sending anything to the AEAT; creating and checking ENI documents; CSV verification legend and seal on several pages.

1. In step 1, tap “Select document” or share the document with GrxFirma from another app.

2. In step 2, choose your certificate file (.p12 or .pfx) and type its password, or use your DNIe.

3. In step 3, tap “Sign document” and choose where to save the signature.

4. The result appears just below, with a check of the new signature.

For PDFs you can add a visible seal. The advanced options let you co-sign, add a certified date and time or choose the format; if you do not open them, a normal signature is made.

1. First choose the document.

2. Tap “Use my DNIe” and type the CAN: the six-digit number printed on the DNIe.

3. Hold the DNIe to the back of the phone and do not move it until reading finishes.

4. When signing, type the DNIe PIN. The key never leaves the card.

The DNIe needs a phone with NFC turned on. It cannot be used to sign several files at once.

1. Choose the signed document in step 1. If the signature is in a separate file (.p7s), also choose the original document.

2. Tap “Verify signature”.

3. The result separates four things: whether the document has changed, whether the certificate was valid, whether its issuer is trusted and whether revocation could be checked.

Offline, only the evidence included in the signature is considered. “Save verification report” stores the technical details.

GrxFirma signs on the phone itself and does not send your documents to any server.

It only connects to the Internet when you ask it to: to add a certified date and time, check whether your certificate is revoked, check a QR code with the AEAT or look for updates.

The certificate stays open only during the session. Tap “Close certificate” when you finish; if you leave the app in the background, it closes by itself after the time chosen in Preferences.

The app does not store passwords, PINs or certificates. Screenshots are blocked in the official version.
